# rok-data

> PostgreSQL data tooling for Rust, consolidated from the rok ecosystem
> (rok-db, rok-fluent, rok-orm, rok-sqlc): one runtime (`rok-data-core` +
> derives via the `rok-data` facade), two generators, one CLI (`rok`,
> published as `rok-data-cli`). The schema directory is the only source
> of truth; `rok init` and `rok gen` turn it into a Rust data layer and
> actix-web or axum API features. Rust ≥ 1.94, PostgreSQL 12+.

## Start here

- [Docs map](README.md): what every file under docs/ is for, and the paste-to-agent conventions.
- [rok-data overview](overview.md): what rok-data is, its crates at a glance, its scope vs. the rok family's sibling project, and the rok-cli/rok-data-cli naming trap.
- [Installation](installation.md): `cargo install rok-data-cli` (binary `rok`), `cargo add rok-data`, platform notes.
- [Getting started](getting-started.md): the front door (`rok init`, `rok gen`, staged migration pairs, CI drift check), the runtime by hand, the legacy generators.

## For agents

- [rok-data for coding agents](coding-agents.md): the machine contracts — `--json` shapes (`StatusRow`), exit codes, the unattended schema-change loop, the repo's agent skills.
- [CLI reference](cli-reference.md): every `rok` command, flag, output and exit code; contract text matching the crates' grammars.
- Agent skills (in-repo): `.agents/skills/rok-data/`, `rok-data-init/`, `rok-data-models/`, `rok-data-migrations/`, `rok-data-sqlc/` — each a `SKILL.md` with triggering descriptions.

- [Migrating to rok-data](migration-guide.md): per-repository notes (rok-db, rok-sqlc, rok-fluent, rok-orm) and the 0.4.0 / 0.3.0 upgrades.
